items.title: Why Franchise Models Are Winning the Restaurant Stock Divide
items.summary: QSR and Yum! Brands posted strong Q2 2026 results on franchise economics and global diversification, while McDonald's U.S. sales slowed on execution missteps despite similar franchise strength.

items.title: Dropping the Dough: Yum! Brands Strategically Trims the Fat

items.title: McDonald’s Is Near a 52-Week Low. Is This the Contrarian Buy of 2026?
